name: avatar-stack
title: Avatar Stack
description: Overlapping avatars that fan out one after another with names beneath, then tuck back in behind the first.

perf.budget: Plain views and images; every face reads one shared value for its offset and name. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The faces spread and stack at once.
a11y.screenReader: One button that names everyone and says whether the stack is expanded.
a11y.touchTarget: The whole stack is the target, at least 44 pt tall.
